name: Hezron
bio: Hezron, a son of Pharez and grandson of Judah, was among the seventy members of Jacob's family who came into Egypt; he became an ancestor of Boaz, Jesse, and King David, and is named in Jesus's genealogy (Genesis 46:12, 27; Ruth 4:18-19; Matthew 1:3). He is a different figure from Hezron, a son of Reuben.
